{{Quote|It's because of the Lactils. They've got so many of those smelly milk-producing creatures on this planet, the situation is now totally out of control.|Han Solo|<ref name="Queen of the Empire">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>	}}
The '''lactil''' was a smelly, hoofed, herd-dwelling [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] found on the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]] that was raised for its [[Milk/Legends|milk]]. The docile [[Species/Legends|creature's]] milk was used to create [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] and [[caf creamer]] that was exported from the planet and for which Chad was well-regarded around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lactils were able to produce large amounts of milk even though Chad had little room for them to [[Diet/Legends|graze]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

However, while lactils greatly benefited Chad's economy, they also exhaled large quantities of [[Methane/Legends|methane]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]], which led to the regular formation of massive storm systems on the planet. The origin of one such storm was explained by the [[New Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]<ref name="Queen of the Empire" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', which includes [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] mention of the lactil, to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> while approaching Chad in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with fellow Rebel [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lactil was first mentioned in ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', a [[1993]] novel by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]] as part of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] series.<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />

''Queen of the Empire'' capitalizes the word "lactil,"<ref name="Queen of the Empire" /> while [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s [[2015]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']] does not.<ref name="Stay on Target" /> As the latter source is more recent, this article follows its capitalization.
